server.name: community-stashpad
server.note_container: the store is written under the working directory, at {root}/.stashpad, so the mount is enough and HOME does not need moving
server.note: the only server in the sample whose write tool takes a caller-supplied id, so a repeat has a key to collapse onto.
server.note_ignore: two of its append-only logs (audit.jsonl, feedback.jsonl) stamp every line with a wall clock time to the millisecond, and handoff files are named with a timestamp and a random suffix. None of them can be compared by digest across a replay, so they are excluded and the two fixtures below are the ones whose effect lands in keyed state. The consequence is reported, not hidden: a repeat of stashpad_feedback appends a second log line that this audit cannot see, so its verdict would be safe-by-absorption when the log in fact grew.
